prompt: A support bot using only embedding search fails on queries like "Error code TS-999". Which addition does Anthropic suggest, and why?

options.text: BM25, because lexical matching finds exact strings such as identifiers and technical terms that embeddings can miss.
A larger chunk size, because longer chunks always contain the identifier.
A lower temperature, because the model is guessing.
Removing the embedding model, because BM25 is strictly better.

explanation: Embeddings capture semantics but can miss exact matches: a query for "TS-999" may surface general error-code content. BM25 ranks by lexical match (building on TF-IDF with document-length and term-frequency saturation), so it catches unique identifiers and technical terms.
